{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Count how many completed orders have revenue = 999999.99
test_order_count = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]

# Verify the value of the test revenue
print(f'Number of completed orders with revenue = 999999.99: {test_order_count}')
print(f'Unique revenue values in completed orders: {df_completed["revenue"].unique()[:15]}')  # Show first 15

# Parse revenue after removing commas
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out test orders
non_test = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = non_test['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print final result
print(f'Total revenue from completed non-test orders: {total_revenue}')"}
